defined_after: inspection of the first Phase 5 turning sensitivity trajectory
future_validation: freeze this rule and test unchanged on independent synthetic cases and other applications; this turning analysis is not external validation
gap_tolerance_interpretation: strictly less than 5 percentage points of normalized gap change in both window transitions; operational, not a statistical error guarantee
epsilon_q_definition: smallest positive normal float64; both adjacent q95 <= epsilon_q means zero normalized gap and DEGENERATE_Q95_SPECTRUM; numerical only, no statistical regularization
ordering_roundoff: reject inversions larger than 8*eps64*max(q_1,epsilon_q); treat smaller negative differences as zero without modifying q95
selected_subsets_rule: exact equality of all selected subset IDs in all three eligible checkpoints, including pairs
global_dimension_rule: exact equality in all three eligible checkpoints; dimension still comes from leading observed>q95 passes
monitored_gaps: all global adjacent gaps plus all adjacent gaps of selected k>=3 subsets with identical IDs throughout the window; no artificial pair gap
gap_stability_rule: every monitored gap change strictly less than tolerance in both transitions using the same monitored set
production_rule: first B>=earliest_full_window_B satisfying stable dimension, selection identities, consistent monitored spectra and both gap transitions
validation_rule: evaluate all 20 prefixes through 2000; B=2000 remains the complete scientific reference
retrospective_rule: compare dimension and selected IDs at stop against every later checkpoint; gap fluctuations alone are not premature decisions
